source.title: Electronic Army Serial Number Merged File, ca. 1938 - 1946
source.recordGroup: RG 64, Records of the National Archives and Records Administration
source.note: One punch card per man entering the Army, 1938-46, converted from 1,586 rolls of 16mm film. NARA compared 377 records against the original cards and found errors in 5 serial numbers and 18 names, so the file is a second reading, not an authority.
